vb_textbox.text: I found that there were generally too matching pairs each time, which were either Green and Brown or Purple and Red for me. It took me a while at the start to work out which colour was best but to begin with you should pick one colour one turn but then pick the other colour the next time you get the choice. You can then quickly find out wehich colour is going to give you the most. Try not to get tempted to change your decision either. There were multiple times where the mushroom count would go down to two or one but then the next time I picked it, it went back up to 5 or 7 for example. I think a good sign when the macthing colour pair is going to change is when you pick one of the colours and it says zero mushrooms. I would then pick one of the other colours in the next choice to see if the colour pair has swapped. I don't think the colour pairs ever swapped for me so it was either Brown and Green or Red and Purple which were the best for me. The colour pairs will probably be different when you do your excercise, however once you figure out the two pairs, just stick to those and follow the steps above. Other than that I don't think there is much more to it, other than keeping your fingers over the keys and pressing them as soon as you can do so that you can make it go quicker. Good luck.
